PositivityTheory.Pf1.HilbertSamuelMoriwa: MoriwakiBigStatement holds: for an arithmetic subvariety X of dimension D+1 of a product of projective spaces over ℤ, birationally parametrised, and a conjugation-invariant hermitian line bundle A that is semipositive, nef on the fibres and nef on the generic fibre, the arithmetic self-intersection (A<sup>D+1</sup>) is at most the arithmetic volume of A.

HSUse holds: the arithmetic Kleiman inequality (A<sup>D+1</sup>) ≥ 0 for semipositive, fibrewise nef A with nonnegative heights on points, the bound limsup log #(small sections of A<sup>⊗n</sup>) / (n<sup>D+1</sup>/(D+1)!) ≤ (A<sup>D+1</sup>) for small-generated data, and the arithmetic Hilbert–Samuel upper bound with respect to the normalised chart lattices.
UpperTheory.BaseChangeIdentities.baseCha: BaseChangeIsobaricN holds: for a CM field E unramified over E<sup>+</sup> at every finite place and every automorphic representation π of the unitary group U(n), there is a partition n = N<sub>1</sub> + ⋯ + N<sub>c</sub> and discrete conjugate self-dual automorphic representations V<sub>i</sub> of GL<sub>N<sub>i</sub></sub>(𝔸<sub>E</sub>) whose isobaric sum is a weak base change of π: at each place the local representation of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>) is a subquotient of the induced product of the (V<sub>i</sub>)<sub>w</sub>, it is spherical where π is unramified, has the base-changed Satake parameters at inert places, matches π<sub>w</sub> at split places, and the infinitesimal characters add up to that of π<sub>∞</sub>.
Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.Qbar: Definition. Q̄ℓ is the algebraic closure of ℚℓ, for a prime ℓ.
Formalism.L2.Host.HChar: Definition. A Hecke character of the number field L is a continuous homomorphism χ: 𝔸L× → ℂ× trivial on the diagonally embedded L×; HChar is the group of these.
GlobalTheory.CuspRep.CG.mk: Definition. For an irreducible cuspidal automorphic subrepresentation π ⊂ C∞(GLa(E)∖GLa(𝔸E)), mk(π) is its isomorphism class, an isomorphism being a linear bijection intertwining the actions of GLa(𝔸E,f), K∞ and the Lie algebra 𝔤∞.
Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.G: Definition. For a field extension Ω/F, G(F, Ω) is the group AutF(Ω) of F-algebra automorphisms of Ω (the absolute Galois group of F when Ω is an algebraic closure).
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.cuspEx: CuspEx holds: for every place w of a number field E and local Artin map a at w there is a map r from irreducible representations of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>) to Weil–Deligne representations which on cuspidal x is irreducible of dimension n, sends a character χ to χ∘a, commutes with real unramified twists ν<sup>s</sup>, satisfies |det r(x)(σ)| = |ω<sub>x</sub>(a(σ))|, satisfies TypeAt x (r x), and, for x a character or a twist of a depth-zero cuspidal over a field isomorphic to ℚ<sub>p</sub>, is compatible with twisting, central characters and contragredients, is injective, and sends depth zero to tame.
GlobalTheory.LocGL.IrrGL.isCusp_ofChar: For every smooth character χ of k<sup>×</sup>, the one-dimensional representation χ of GL<sub>1</sub>(k) is cuspidal.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.typeIff: TypeIff holds: for every place w of a number field E and every map rc from irreducible representations of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>) to Weil–Deligne representations, the type law for rc (formulated over all unramified extensions E′ with a degree-n residue extension and their tame inertia characters) is equivalent to TypeAt x (rc x) for every x.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.TypeAt: Definition. TypeAt x V holds when, for every prime g with Ew ≅ ℚg continuously, every n ≥ 1, every unramified extension datum with residue field K = 𝔽gn and tame inertia character R: I → K×, every regular character θ of K× and the cuspidal representation τ of GLn(𝔽g) with character τ(y) = (−1)n−1 Σj<n θ(zgj) on elliptic y with eigenvalue z, if a representative σ of x contains the inflation of τ to GLn(ℤg), then V has monodromy N = 0 and every inertia element t acts on V with characteristic polynomial ∏j<n(X − θ(R(t)gj)).
DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzLc.isCuspidal_of_: Let k ≅ ℚ<sub>g</sub> continuously and let τ be a representation of GL<sub>n</sub>(𝔽<sub>g</sub>) with cuspidal irreducible character. If an irreducible smooth representation σ of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) admits a nonzero GL<sub>n</sub>(ℤ<sub>g</sub>)-equivariant map from the inflation of τ, then σ is cuspidal.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extDepth: ExtDepth holds: for every number field E, algebraic closure Ω, place A of Ω above a finite place w of E, local Artin map a: W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> → E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup>, map r on cuspidal irreducible representations satisfying the cuspidal laws CuspT, and Langlands extension rc of r (rc(x) = Σ<sub>Δ</sub> r(Δ) ⊗ ν<sup>(ℓ(Δ)−1)/2</sup> ⊗ Sp(ℓ(Δ)) over the multisegment of x), if x has supercuspidal support consisting of good cuspidals (characters, or twists of depth-zero cuspidals over a field isomorphic to ℚ<sub>p</sub>) and x has nonzero vectors fixed by the principal congruence subgroup K(1), then rc(x) is tame.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extTw: ExtTw holds: for every number field E, algebraic closure Ω, place A of Ω above a finite place w of E, local Artin map a: W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> → E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup>, map r on cuspidal irreducible representations satisfying the cuspidal laws CuspT, and Langlands extension rc of r (rc(x) = Σ<sub>Δ</sub> r(Δ) ⊗ ν<sup>(ℓ(Δ)−1)/2</sup> ⊗ Sp(ℓ(Δ)) over the multisegment of x), one has rc(x ⊗ ν<sup>s</sup>) = rc(x) ⊗ ν<sup>s</sup> for all real s, and rc(x ⊗ χ) = rc(x) ⊗ (χ∘a) for every smooth character χ when the cuspidal support of x is good.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.exists_isLExt: LanglandsExhaustionGL and LanglandsMultisegments ⟹ for every place w of a number field and every map r from irreducible representations of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>) to Weil–Deligne representations, there exists rc with rc(x) = Σ<sub>Δ∈𝔪</sub> r(Δ) ⊗ ν<sup>(ℓ(Δ)−1)/2</sup> ⊗ Sp(ℓ(Δ)) whenever x is the Langlands quotient of the multisegment 𝔪, and every such rc agrees with r on cuspidal representations.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extDual: ExtDual holds: for every number field E, algebraic closure Ω, place A of Ω above a finite place w of E, local Artin map a: W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> → E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup>, map r on cuspidal irreducible representations satisfying the cuspidal laws CuspT, and Langlands extension rc of r (rc(x) = Σ<sub>Δ</sub> r(Δ) ⊗ ν<sup>(ℓ(Δ)−1)/2</sup> ⊗ Sp(ℓ(Δ)) over the multisegment of x), if π has good cuspidal support and π′ ≅ π<sup>∨</sup>, then rc(π′) = rc(π)<sup>∨</sup>.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extInj: ExtInj holds: for every number field E, algebraic closure Ω, place A of Ω above a finite place w of E, local Artin map a: W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> → E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup>, map r on cuspidal irreducible representations satisfying the cuspidal laws CuspT, and Langlands extension rc of r (rc(x) = Σ<sub>Δ</sub> r(Δ) ⊗ ν<sup>(ℓ(Δ)−1)/2</sup> ⊗ Sp(ℓ(Δ)) over the multisegment of x), if y has good cuspidal support and rc(x) = rc(y), then x = y.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.extDim: ExtDim holds: for every number field E, algebraic closure Ω, place A of Ω above a finite place w of E, local Artin map a: W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> → E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup>, map r on cuspidal irreducible representations satisfying the cuspidal laws CuspT, and Langlands extension rc of r (rc(x) = Σ<sub>Δ</sub> r(Δ) ⊗ ν<sup>(ℓ(Δ)−1)/2</sup> ⊗ Sp(ℓ(Δ)) over the multisegment of x), every irreducible x of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>) has dim rc(x) = n and charpoly rc(x)(σ) = ∏<sub>y</sub> charpoly r(y)(σ) over its cuspidal support, and if ω is the central character of x then |det rc(x)(σ)| = |ω(a(σ))|, with equality det rc(x)(σ) = ω(a(σ)) when the cuspidal support is good.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.segSum: Definition. For a map rc on irreducible representations and a list of segments l, segSum(rc, l) = ⊕Δ∈l rc(ρΔ) ⊗ ν(ℓ(Δ)−1)/2 ⊗ Sp(ℓ(Δ)), where ρΔ is the first cuspidal of Δ, ℓ(Δ) its length, ν the unramified twist by |·|, and Sp(m) the m-dimensional special Weil–Deligne representation.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.artEx: ArtEx holds: for every finite place w of a number field E there is a unique local Artin map a: W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> → E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup>, namely a surjective homomorphism continuous on inertia with ord(a(σ)) = −deg σ, through which every smooth character of W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> factors, and compatible with every global Artin map.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Pr.exh: LanglandsExhaustionGL holds: for every nonarchimedean local field k of characteristic 0, every irreducible smooth representation of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) is the Langlands quotient (unique irreducible quotient of the standard product of segment representations) of some multisegment.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Pr.multi: LanglandsMultisegments holds: for every nonarchimedean local field k of characteristic 0, the multisegment whose Langlands quotient is a given irreducible representation is unique, and if x<sub>0</sub>, x<sub>1</sub>, y are the Langlands quotients of 𝔪, 𝔫, 𝔪 + 𝔫 then y is a subquotient of x<sub>0</sub> × x<sub>1</sub>.
UpperTheory.Gal.Int.Geo.geoOne_holds: GeoOne holds: for a CM field E, odd a, auxiliary imaginary quadratic data, and an automorphic representation U of the unitary group in a variables satisfying the stated level, type and weight conditions at places above ℓ, there exist ℓ-adic Galois representations ρ: G<sub>E</sub> → GL<sub>d</sub>(Q̄<sub>ℓ</sub>) in the base family of U whose Frobenius eigenvalues at unramified places prime to ℓ match the Satake parameters, and which at the designated places above ℓ are crystalline with the prescribed Hodge–Tate jumps.
UpperTheory.Gal.Int.galoisLocalGlobalStr: GeoOne and TLiftK ⟹ Row0b for recT: for a CM field E and a regular algebraic polarised cuspidal automorphic representation π of GL<sub>a</sub>(𝔸<sub>E</sub>) there is a continuous semisimple ρ: G<sub>E</sub> → GL<sub>a</sub>(Q̄<sub>ℓ</sub>) with Hodge–Tate weights given by the infinity type, conjugation-symmetric weights, compatibility with the local Langlands correspondence at places w ∤ ℓ (in the bounded form AwayB), and crystalline, de Rham and potentially semistable behaviour with the prescribed Hodge–Tate jumps at places above ℓ.
PositivityTheory.ResPlug.FromRes.resK: ResKStatement holds: for a field K of characteristic 0, a reduced closed subscheme X ⊂ ℙ<sup>M</sup><sub>K</sub> and a dense open U ⊂ X smooth of dimension D, there exist a closed subscheme X′ ⊂ ℙ<sup>M</sup> × ℙ<sup>r</sup> smooth of dimension D and a morphism f: X′ → X compatible with the projection, an isomorphism over U with f<sup>−1</sup>(U) dense, whose boundary X′ ∖ f<sup>−1</sup>(U) is a simple normal crossings divisor in local coordinates.
GlobalTheory.T.arith_intersection_system: The arithmetic Poincaré–Lelong formula and ResKStatement ⟹ ArithIntersectionSystemStatement: there is an arithmetic intersection system on subvarieties of products of projective spaces over ℤ that is multilinear in smooth hermitian line bundles, satisfies the projection formula with the field-degree factor under block maps, and vanishes when more bundles are pulled back than the image dimension.
ReciprocityTheory.ChartRestriction.G.Ara: Definition. MoriwakiBigStatement asserts: for every intersection system II, every arithmetic variety X of dimension D+1 in a product of projective spaces over ℤ given by a birational coordinate map y, and every conjugation-invariant hermitian line bundle A semipositive relative to P0 ⊆ X, nef on the fibres and nef on the generic fibre, II(AD+1) ≤ limsupk log #{small sections of A⊗k in the chart lattice} / (kD+1/(D+1)!).
PositivityTheory.Pf1.HilbertSamuelMoriwa: ResKStatement, ArithIntersectionSystemStatement and DenseBoundedHeight ⟹ MoriwakiBigStatement: the arithmetic self-intersection of a semipositive, fibrewise and generically nef hermitian line bundle is bounded by its arithmetic volume.
PositivityTheory.MbAis.DenseCurves.main: DenseBoundedHeight holds: for every intersection family, every arithmetic variety X of dimension D+1 in a product of projective spaces over ℤ and every smooth hermitian line bundle H of multidegree 1, there are C ∈ ℝ and a Zariski-dense set of arithmetic points of X (subvarieties of dimension 1) each of H-height at most C.
PositivityTheory.Pf1.HilbertSamuelMoriwa: Definition. HSUse is the conjunction of three statements: the arithmetic Kleiman inequality II(AD+1) ≥ 0 for semipositive, conjugation-invariant, fibrewise nef A with nonnegative heights on all arithmetic points; the bound limsupn log #(small sections of A⊗n) / (nD+1/(D+1)!) ≤ II(AD+1) for small-generated data; and the arithmetic Hilbert–Samuel upper bound for semipositive A with bounded monomials.
ResKStatement, ArithIntersectionSystemStatement and DenseBoundedHeight ⟹ HSUse (the arithmetic Kleiman inequality together with the two arithmetic Hilbert–Samuel upper bounds).
PositivityTheory.Rg.BcN.BaseChangeIsobar: Definition. BaseChangeIsobaricN asserts: for every CM field E unramified over E+ at all finite places, every n ≥ 1 and every automorphic representation π of U(n)(𝔸E+), there exist n = Σi Ni, discrete automorphic representations Vi of GLNi(𝔸E) arising from unitary conjugate self-dual cuspidal representations, and irreducible Pw of GLn(Ew) such that Pw is a subquotient of the parabolic induction of the local components (Vi)w, Pw is spherical where π is unramified, carries the base-changed Satake parameters at inert places, is the local component of π at split places, and the infinitesimal characters of the Vi sum to that of the weight of π.
UpperTheory.HeckeLevelFrameExistence.can: CandFin holds: for a CM field E, an automorphic representation π of U(n) with a fixed frame of auxiliary level data, and a finite set T′ of non-split good places, the candidate isobaric decompositions attached to π have only finitely many Jacquet eigenvalue pairs at each w ∈ T′, realise finitely many semisimplified local products with the same fixed-vector dimensions at each w ∈ S<sub>0</sub>, and have uniformly bounded Iwahori-type fixed-vector dimensions on T′.
GlobalTheory.CuspRep.IsCuspForm: Definition. A smooth function φ on GLa(𝔸E) is a cusp form if it is an automorphic form (left GLa(E)-invariant, right-invariant under an open subgroup of GLa(𝔸E,f), K∞-finite, 𝒵(𝔤)-finite, of moderate growth) and ∫Nr(E)∖Nr(𝔸) φ(ug) du = 0 for every g and every unipotent radical Nr of the standard parabolic of type (r, a−r), 0 < r < a.
GlobalTheory.CuspRep.IsStable: Definition. A subspace V of smooth functions on GLa(𝔸E) is stable if it is preserved by right translation by GLa(𝔸E,f) and by K∞, and by the action of the Lie algebra 𝔤∞.
GlobalTheory.CuspRep.Sm: Definition. Sm(E, a) is the space of functions φ: GLa(𝔸E) → ℂ such that for every g the map x ↦ φ(g·x) is C∞ (over ℝ) on GLa(E ⊗ ℝ) = GLa(ℂ)r2, viewed as an open subset of matrices.
Formalism.BasicNotions.LocTied: Definition. A tie of a period-ring package P (with an Ainf datum) to the concrete period rings consists of ring isomorphisms B ≅ Bcris and BdR ≅ BdR compatible with ℤℓ, with the Gℚℓ-actions, with Frobenius, with the inclusion Bcris ⊂ BdR, with the filtrations, and with Ainf, such that Q̄ℓ lands in BdR+ lifting θ and t is sent to log[ε].
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.wdOf: Definition. For a place w ∤ ℓ, an isomorphism ι: Q̄ℓ ≅ ℂ and r: GE → GLn(Q̄ℓ), wdOf(r) is the Frobenius-semisimple Weil–Deligne representation of WEw obtained from r|GEw by Grothendieck's monodromy theorem and transported by ι (the trivial n-dimensional representation if none exists).
GlobalTheory.GalOfCusp.algNorm: Definition. For an irreducible smooth representation σ of GLa(Ew), algNorm(σ) = σ ⊗ |det|(1−a)/2, the arithmetic normalisation.
GlobalTheory.Pst.Induces: Definition. An embedding j: Ω → Q̄ℓ (from a local bridge at w) induces the place A if A = {x ∈ Ω : |j(x)| ≤ 1}.
Formalism.BasicNotions.LocPrime: Definition. A local period package at ℓ consists of ℚℓ-algebras B and BdR with Gℚℓ-actions, a Frobenius φ on B, an embedding B → BdR, an element t, a character χ: Gℚℓ → ℚℓ× and, for each finite extension K/ℚℓ, period data (filtration, Frobenius, actions) on these rings, all compatible, with χ the cyclotomic character on a fixed compatible system of ℓ-power roots of unity, Frobenius lifting x ↦ xℓ on the maximal unramified subfield, and normalised valuations on finite extensions.
Formalism.BasicNotions.LocBridge: Definition. For a subgroup Gw ⊂ Gal(Ω/E) and a topological ℤl-algebra O, an l-adic local bridge consists of a finite extension Kw/ℚl inside ℚ̄l, an embedding j : Ω → ℚ̄l with j(E) ⊂ Kw dense, a topological isomorphism e : Gw ≅ Gal(ℚ̄l/Kw) with e(g)(j(x)) = j(g(x)), a finite extension L/ℚl containing τ(Kw) for every ℚl-embedding τ, and a topological ℤl-algebra isomorphism O ≅ 𝒪L.
Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.IsPlaceOver: Definition. A valuation ring A of Ω lies over the finite place v of F if, for every x ∈ 𝒪F, one has |x|A < 1 ⟺ x ∈ 𝔭v.
UpperTheory.GalStar.AwayB: Definition. For Weil–Deligne classes x, y of WEw, AwayB(x, y) means: dim x = dim y; if every commutator in WEw acts on y with characteristic polynomial (X−1)dim y and Ny = 0, then x = y; and if Ew ≅ ℚg continuously with dim y = 1 or 16(dim y)2 < g, wild inertia acts unipotently on y, every eigenvalue of multiplicity ≥ 2 of an element topologically generating inertia modulo wild inertia satisfies zq−1 = 1, and Ny = 0, then Nx = 0 and x, y have the same characteristic polynomials on inertia (degree-0 elements).
UpperTheory.GalStar.AboveB: Definition. For a cuspidal automorphic π of GLa(𝔸E), ι : ℚ̄l ≅ ℂ, r : Gal(Ω/E) → GLa(ℚ̄l), Hodge–Tate data HT and a local bridge at w, AboveB requires: if the local component σ of π at w is spherical then r|Gw is crystalline and de Rham with τ-Hodge–Tate multiset HT(τ); and for every local reciprocity map rc satisfying Rc, if rc(σ ⊗ |det|(1−a)/2) has N = 0 and either (Ew ≅ ℚg with a = 1 or 16a2 < g, wild inertia acts unipotently, and the eigenvalue-multiplicity condition of AwayB holds) or all commutators act unipotently, then r|Gw is de Rham and potentially semistable with Hodge–Tate multisets HT(τ), and AwayB(WD(r|Gw), rc(σ ⊗ |det|(1−a)/2)) holds.
Formalism.BasicNotions.LocAinf: Definition. Relative to l-adic period-ring data P, an Ainf-structure consists of a norm-preserving action of Gℚl on ℂl extending the action on ℚ̄l, a compatible action on the tilt 𝒪ℂl♭, a compatible system (ζn) of ln-th roots of unity with ζ1 ≠ 1 matching P, the element ε = (ζn) ∈ 𝒪♭, and an injective Galois- and Frobenius-equivariant ring map ι : Ainf → B, such that ι(Ainf) ⊂ Fil0BdR, ι(a) ∈ Fil1 exactly when a is divisible by Σi<l[ε1/l]i, and ι sends the Teichmüller lift of a compatible system of roots of a prime-to-l root of unity c ∈ ℚlur to c.
Neutral.B1.Dec: Definition. The decomposition group of a valuation ring A of Ω: the subgroup {σ ∈ Gal(Ω/F) : σ(A) = A}.
Formalism.MainNotions.N.IsSSRep: Definition. A representation ρ : Γ → GLa(k) is semisimple if every ρ-stable subspace W ⊂ ka admits a ρ-stable complement.
Formalism.L2.Host.hcharSub: Definition. The subgroup of Hom(𝔸L×, ℂ×) consisting of continuous characters trivial on the diagonally embedded L×, i.e. the group of (not necessarily unitary) Hecke characters of L.
GlobalTheory.CuspRep.CG: Definition. The set of isomorphism classes of irreducible cuspidal automorphic subspaces of GLa(𝔸E), two being isomorphic when a linear isomorphism intertwines the actions of GLa(𝔸E,f), K∞ and the Lie algebra.
GlobalTheory.GalOfCusp.compNorm: Definition. For a CM field E with maximal totally real subfield E+, the homomorphism from Hecke characters of E+ to Hecke characters of E given by χ ↦ χ ∘ NE/E+ on ideles.
GlobalTheory.ContraPair.DualIsConjBy: Definition. For a cuspidal automorphic π of GLa(𝔸L), L CM, and a Hecke character ψ, there is a nondegenerate bilinear pairing B between π ⊗ ψ−1 and π with B(gφ, c(g)φ′) = B(φ, φ′) for g in GLa(𝔸L,f) and K∞ and B(Xφ, φ′) + B(φ, X̄φ′) = 0 on the Lie algebra, where c is complex conjugation; equivalently (π ⊗ ψ−1)∨ ≅ πc.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.good_cases: If x is an irreducible cuspidal representation of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>) with GoodCusp x, then either n = 1, or E<sub>w</sub> ≅ ℚ<sub>g</sub> continuously for some prime g and x ≅ y ⊗ (χ ∘ det) with y cuspidal having a nonzero vector fixed by K(1) = ker(GL<sub>n</sub>(𝒪) → GL<sub>n</sub>(𝔽)) and χ a smooth character.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.goodCusp_self: If E<sub>w</sub> ≅ ℚ<sub>g</sub> continuously for some prime g and y is an irreducible representation of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>) with a nonzero K(1)-fixed vector, then GoodCusp y holds.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.lpTw_eq: For a local Artin map a : W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> → E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup>, a Weil–Deligne class V and s ∈ ℝ, the unramified twist V(s) (σ ↦ q<sup>s·deg σ</sup>) equals V ⊗ (|·|<sup>s</sup> ∘ a).
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.twist_twist: For a local Artin map a, a Weil–Deligne class V and smooth characters χ, χ′ of E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup>, (V ⊗ (χ ∘ a)) ⊗ (χ′ ∘ a) = V ⊗ ((χχ′) ∘ a).
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.DZ: Definition. An irreducible smooth representation y of GLn(k) has depth zero (in this sense) if it has a nonzero vector fixed by K(1) = ker(GLn(𝒪k) → GLn(𝔽k)).
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Gm: Definition. For a local Artin map a, a map r from irreducible representations of the groups GLn(Ew) to Weil–Deligne classes satisfies Gm if r(χ) = χ ∘ a for smooth characters χ of GL1, r(x ⊗ χ∘det) = r(x) ⊗ (χ ∘ a) for every cuspidal x with GoodCusp x, and, when Ew ≅ ℚg, every cuspidal y with a nonzero K(1)-fixed vector satisfies Par: r(y) is irreducible, tamely ramified, of dimension n, with det r(y)(σ) = ωy(a(σ)) for the central character ωy, and r(y) satisfies the inertial type condition TypeAt.
DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzType.lDepth: LDepth holds: if E<sub>w</sub> ≅ ℚ<sub>g</sub> continuously and an irreducible smooth representation σ of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>), restricted to GL<sub>n</sub>(ℤ<sub>g</sub>), contains the inflation of some representation τ of GL<sub>n</sub>(𝔽<sub>g</sub>), then σ has a nonzero vector fixed by K(1) = ker(GL<sub>n</sub>(ℤ<sub>g</sub>) → GL<sub>n</sub>(𝔽<sub>g</sub>)).
GlobalTheory.SmGL.HasCentralChar: Definition. A representation π of GLn(R) has central character ω : R× → ℂ× if π(z·1)v = ω(z)v for all z ∈ R× and all v.
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.lpTw_zero: For every Weil–Deligne class V, the unramified twist V(0) equals V.
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.lpTw_add: For every Weil–Deligne class V and s, t ∈ ℝ, V(s)(t) = V(s + t), where V(s) denotes the twist by σ ↦ q<sup>s·deg σ</sup>.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.CuspEx: Definition. CuspEx asserts that for every number field E, finite place w, valuation ring A over w and local Artin map a, there is a map r from irreducible representations of GLn(Ew) to Weil–Deligne classes which on cuspidal x gives irreducible r(x) of dimension n, with r(χ) = χ ∘ a, r(x ⊗ |det|s) = r(x)(s), |det r(x)(σ)| = |ωx(a(σ))|, and, for x satisfying GoodCusp, compatibility with twists, det r(x) = ωx ∘ a, r(x∨) = r(x)∨, injectivity, and tameness of r(x) when x has a nonzero K(1)-fixed vector, together with the inertial type condition TypeAt for every cuspidal x.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.IsIrrWD: Definition. A Weil–Deligne class x is irreducible if it is represented by some (ρ, N) on ℂn whose Weil-group representation ρ is irreducible.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.goodMap: GoodMap holds: for every place w and local Artin map a there is a map r from irreducible representations of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>) to Weil–Deligne classes with r(χ) = χ ∘ a for characters, r(x ⊗ χ∘det) = r(x) ⊗ (χ ∘ a) for cuspidal x with GoodCusp x, and, when E<sub>w</sub> ≅ ℚ<sub>g</sub>, r(y) satisfying the parameter conditions Par (irreducible, tame, dimension n, determinant ω<sub>y</sub> ∘ a, type TypeAt) for every cuspidal y with a nonzero K(1)-fixed vector.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.wDBasic: WDBasic holds: for every Weil–Deligne class V of W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub>, det V is a character of W, characters of W are determined by their values on inertia and one Frobenius, irreducible V has N = 0, positive dimension and irreducible dual, duality preserves tameness and dimension and inverts det and inertial eigenvalues; and twisting by a smooth character ξ preserves dimension and irreducibility, multiplies det by ξ<sup>dim V</sup> and inertial eigenvalues by ξ, is associative and trivial for ξ = 1, commutes with duality via ξ<sup>−1</sup>, preserves tameness when ξ is trivial on wild inertia, and, for V and V ⊗ ξ both tame with dim V > 0, forces ξ to be trivial on wild inertia.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.junkEx: JunkEx holds: for every place w and every n ≥ 2 there is an irreducible n-dimensional Weil–Deligne class J with |det J(σ)| = 1 for all σ ∈ W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> such that, when E<sub>w</sub> ≅ ℚ<sub>g</sub>, J is not a twist of any tamely ramified Weil–Deligne class.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.H1: Definition. For a representation of G on M, H1 is the quotient of the continuous 1-cocycles (f(gh) = f(g) + g·f(h)) by the coboundaries g ↦ g·m − m.
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.H2: Definition. For a representation of G on M, H2 is the quotient of the continuous 2-cocycles (g·f(h,k) − f(gh,k) + f(g,hk) − f(g,h) = 0) by the coboundaries of continuous 1-cochains, (g,h) ↦ g·c(h) − c(gh) + c(g).
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.expo: Expo holds: for every place w and local Artin map a there is e assigning a real number to each irreducible representation x of GL<sub>n</sub>(E<sub>w</sub>), n > 0, with e(x ⊗ |det|<sup>s</sup>) = e(x) + s and such that every n-dimensional Weil–Deligne class J with |det J| ≡ 1 satisfies |det J(e(x))(σ)| = |ω<sub>x</sub>(a(σ))| for the central character ω<sub>x</sub> of x.
GlobalTheory.LocGL.isSmoothChar_absPow: For every s ∈ ℂ, the character x ↦ |x|<sup>s</sup> of k<sup>×</sup> is smooth.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.clBasic: ClBasic holds: over a nonarchimedean local field k of characteristic zero, every irreducible smooth representation y of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) has a unique, smooth central character; twisting by χ∘det preserves n, cuspidality and GoodCusp, composes multiplicatively, is trivial for χ = 1 and multiplies the central character by χ<sup>n</sup>; cuspidal implies n > 0 and n = 1 implies y is a cuspidal character; and y has a unique contragredient y′, which has the same n, cuspidality, K(1)-fixed vectors and GoodCusp, satisfies (y ⊗ χ)′ = y′ ⊗ χ<sup>−1</sup>, and has central character ω<sup>−1</sup>.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.GoodCusp: Definition. An irreducible representation y of GLn(k) satisfies GoodCusp if n = 1, or k ≅ ℚg continuously for some prime g and y ≅ y0 ⊗ (χ ∘ det) for a smooth character χ and some y0 with a nonzero vector fixed by K(1) = ker(GLn(𝒪k) → GLn(𝔽k)).
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.lpZero: Definition. The class of the zero-dimensional Weil–Deligne representation.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.parOne: ParOne holds: for every smooth character χ of E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup> and local Artin map a, χ ∘ a is an irreducible one-dimensional Weil–Deligne class with det = χ ∘ a, χ is the central character of χ viewed on GL<sub>1</sub>, χ has nonzero K(1)-fixed vectors iff χ is trivial on 1 + 𝔭, in which case the pair (χ, χ ∘ a) satisfies Par; moreover twisting and contragredients correspond (χ ⊗ χ′ ↦ (χχ′) ∘ a, χ<sup>∨</sup> = χ<sup>−1</sup>), and χ is determined by its class.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.charZero_compl: For every finite place w of a number field E, the completion E<sub>w</sub> has characteristic zero.
GlobalTheory.LocGL.isCuspidal_of_equiv: If π ≅ σ as representations of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) and π is cuspidal, then σ is cuspidal.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.IsSmoothChar: Definition. A character χ : G → F× of a topological group is smooth if ker χ is open.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.isCuspidal_detRep_one: For every smooth character χ of k<sup>×</sup>, the one-dimensional representation χ ∘ det of GL<sub>1</sub>(k) is cuspidal.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.IrrRep.nonempty_equiv_: Every irreducible smooth representation σ is isomorphic to the chosen representative of its isomorphism class.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.IrrRep.det: Definition. For a smooth character χ of k×, the irreducible smooth one-dimensional representation g ↦ χ(det g) of GLn(k).
GlobalTheory.LocGL.IrrGL.ofChar: Definition. For a smooth character χ of k×, the element (1, [χ]) of the set of pairs (n, isomorphism class of irreducible smooth representation of GLn(k)), i.e. χ regarded as a representation of GL1(k).
GlobalTheory.LocGL.IrrGL.IsCusp: Definition. An irreducible smooth representation x of GLn(k) is cuspidal if n > 0 and x is smooth with zero Jacquet module along the unipotent radical of every proper standard parabolic subgroup.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.resEx: ResEx holds: for every number field E with algebraic closure Ω, valuation ring A of Ω over a finite place w, prime g with a continuous isomorphism ℚ<sub>g</sub> ≅ E<sub>w</sub>, n > 0 and every extension datum D (E′, w′, a′, red : 𝒪<sub>E′</sub> ↠ K), there is a homomorphism R : I<sub>E</sub> → K<sup>×</sup> reducing the local Artin map of E′ on inertia, and every such R is surjective with open kernel, trivial on wild inertia, satisfies Nw = g and [K : 𝔽<sub>g</sub>] = n, and obeys R(σtσ<sup>−1</sup>) = R(t)<sup>g</sup> for every Weil element σ of degree 1.
DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzType.ine_lift: Let E ⊂ E′ be number fields with common algebraic closure Ω, A a valuation ring of Ω lying over places w of E and w′ of E′, g a prime with g ∉ w′<sup>2</sup> and Nw′ = g<sup>n</sup> for some n > 0. Then every σ in the inertia group I<sub>E</sub>(A) ⊂ Gal(Ω/E) fixes E′ and lies in I<sub>E′</sub>(A).
ReciprocityTheory.Gal.Ine: Definition. For a valuation ring A of Ω, the inertia subgroup IF(A) ⊂ Gal(Ω/F) consists of those σ with σA = A and vA(σx − x) < 1 for every x ∈ Ω with vA(x) ≤ 1.
DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzType.val_artin_in: If a′ : W<sub>E′</sub> → (E′<sub>w′</sub>)<sup>×</sup> is a local Artin map, then |a′(t)| = 1 for every t in the inertia group, i.e. a′ maps inertia into 𝒪<sub>E′<sub>w′</sub></sub><sup>×</sup>.
DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzType.red_ne_zero_: Let a′ be a local Artin map for E′ at w′ and red : 𝒪<sub>E′</sub> → K a ring homomorphism to a field with kernel w′. If t lies in inertia and x ∈ 𝒪<sub>E′</sub> satisfies |a′(t) − x| < 1 in E′<sub>w′</sub>, then red(x) ≠ 0.
DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzType.exists_int_a: For every u in the completion E<sub>w</sub> with |u| ≤ 1 there is x ∈ 𝒪<sub>E</sub> with |u − x| < 1.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.TypeIff: Definition. TypeIff is the proposition that for every place w of a number field E (with Ω, A as above) and every map rc from irreducible smooth representations of GLn(Ew) to Weil–Deligne classes, the unbundled type law TypeLaw(rc) holds if and only if TypeAt(x, rc(x)) holds for every x; both assert that whenever x contains the inflation of a cuspidal representation τ of GLn(𝔽g) attached by Green's formula to a regular character θ, rc(x) has N = 0 and inertia characteristic polynomial ∏j<n(X − θ(R(t)gj)).
GlobalTheory.SerSys.TameGen.Inflates: Definition. A representation π of GLn(ℚg) on V contains the inflation of a representation τ of GLn(𝔽g) if there is a nonzero ℂ-linear φ : τ → V with φ(τ(k̄)w) = π(k)φ(w) for all k ∈ GLn(ℤg), where k̄ is the reduction of k mod g.
GlobalTheory.GLq.Gn: Definition. Gn = GLn(ℤ/gℤ), the finite general linear group over 𝔽g.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.IrrRep: Definition. An irreducible smooth representation of a topological group G: a complex vector space V with a representation ρ : G → GL(V) that is irreducible and smooth (every vector has an open stabilizer).
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Names: Definition. For a field K ⊇ 𝔽g, a character θ of K× names a representation τ of GLn(𝔽g) if for every y ∈ GLn(𝔽g) with irreducible characteristic polynomial and every root z ∈ K× of that polynomial, tr τ(y) = (−1)n−1 ∑j=0n−1 θ(zgj).
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Ext: Definition. An extension datum of degree n over (E, w, A) at the prime g: a number field E′ ⊇ E inside Ω with a place w′ under A such that g ∉ w′2 and Nw′ = gn, a local Artin map a′ : WE′ → (E′w′)×, and a surjective ring homomorphism red : 𝒪E′ → K onto a field K over 𝔽g with kernel w′.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.InFor: Definition. Given R : IE → K× and a character θ of K×, a Weil–Deligne class V satisfies the inertia formula if for every t in inertia the characteristic polynomial of V(t) equals ∏j=0n−1(X − θ(R(t)gj)).
GlobalTheory.Published.IsRegularChar: Definition. A character θ of K× is regular (relative to g and d) if the characters θgi for 0 ≤ i < d are pairwise distinct.
GlobalTheory.GLq.IsCusp: Definition. A class function χ on GLd(𝔽g) is cuspidal if d > 0, χ is an irreducible character, and for every 0 < a < d the sum of χ over the unipotent radical of the standard (a, d−a) parabolic (block upper unitriangular matrices) vanishes.
GlobalTheory.PRep.twKer: Definition. For a representation ρ of G on V, a subgroup N and a character ψ of N, V(N, ψ) is the span of all ρ(n)v − ψ(n)v with n ∈ N, v ∈ V (the kernel of the twisted Jacquet functor).
DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzLc.twKer_twoBlock: Let k be a local field with a continuous isomorphism ℚ<sub>g</sub> ≅ k, 0 < a < n, τ a cuspidal representation of GL<sub>n</sub>(𝔽<sub>g</sub>), and σ an irreducible smooth representation of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) containing the inflation of τ. Then V(U<sub>a,n−a</sub>) = V for the unipotent radical U<sub>a,n−a</sub> of the (a, n−a) parabolic, so the Jacquet module of σ along it vanishes.
GlobalTheory.FiniteGL.unipRadical: Definition. For a labelling b : {1,…,N} → ℕ, the subgroup of GLN(k) of matrices u with (u − 1)ij = 0 whenever b(j) ≤ b(i), i.e. the unipotent radical of the block upper-triangular parabolic determined by b.
GlobalTheory.FiniteGL.twoBlocks: Definition. The labelling of {0,…,N−1} with b(i) = 0 for i < a and b(i) = 1 otherwise, defining the (a, N−a) block decomposition.
DiscreteGroups.sglob.DzLc.exists_perm_co: If a block decomposition e of {1,…,N} into blocks of sizes d<sub>1</sub>,…,d<sub>s</sub> has nontrivial unipotent radical U<sub>e</sub>, then there are Q ∈ GL<sub>N</sub>(F) and 0 < a < N with Q U<sub>a,N−a</sub> Q<sup>−1</sup> ⊆ U<sub>e</sub>.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.unipRad: Definition. For a block decomposition e of the index set, the unipotent radical of the block upper-triangular parabolic Pe ⊂ GLn(R): the elements of Pe whose diagonal blocks are all identity matrices (kernel of the Levi projection).
GlobalTheory.LocalData.complRel: Definition. The valuative relation on the completion Fp of a number field at a finite prime p induced by its canonical ℤ-valued valuation.
GlobalTheory.LocalData.isLocalField: With the valuative relation induced by its valuation, the completion F<sub>p</sub> of a number field at a finite prime p is a nonarchimedean local field.
GlobalTheory.LlcDepth.prod_map_pow: For q ∈ ℂ[X], f : α → ℕ and a finite multiset s of α, ∏<sub>y∈s</sub> q<sup>f(y)</sup> = q<sup>∑<sub>y∈s</sub> f(y)</sup>.
GlobalTheory.SplitRead.Irr.ofIrrRep: Definition. The repackaging of an irreducible smooth representation σ of GLn(k) as an element of Irr(k, n), with the same space, action, smoothness and irreducibility.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Pr.dzs: DepthZeroSupport holds: if an irreducible smooth representation π of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) has a nonzero vector fixed by K<sub>1</sub> = ker(GL<sub>n</sub>(𝒪<sub>k</sub>) → GL<sub>n</sub>(residue field)) and has cuspidal support (σ<sub>1</sub>,…,σ<sub>s</sub>), then each σ<sub>a</sub> has a nonzero K<sub>1</sub>-fixed vector.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.ExtDepth: Definition. ExtDepth is the proposition that, for every place w with local Artin map a, every assignment r on cuspidal representations satisfying the cuspidal laws CuspT and every Langlands extension rc of r, rc(x) is tame (trivial on wild inertia) whenever x is Good and has a nonzero K1-fixed vector.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.goodSeg: GoodSeg holds: for every characteristic-zero nonarchimedean local field k, (i) if x is the Langlands quotient of a multisegment l, then x is Good iff the first cuspidal of every segment of l is Good; (ii) a cuspidal x is Good iff it is a good cuspidal (GL<sub>1</sub>, or over k ≅ ℚ<sub>g</sub> a character twist of a depth-zero representation); (iii) the cuspidal support of an irreducible representation is unique.
GlobalTheory.LocGL.HasSupport.sum_fst: If a representation π of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) has cuspidal support s = {σ<sub>1</sub>,…,σ<sub>h</sub>} with σ<sub>i</sub> a representation of GL<sub>n<sub>i</sub></sub>(k), then ∑ n<sub>i</sub> = n.
GlobalTheory.T.isTameWeilDeligne_iff_wil: A Weil–Deligne class y is tame (has a representative trivial on wild inertia) iff for every wild σ in the Weil group the characteristic polynomial of y(σ) equals (X − 1)<sup>dim y</sup>.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.absPow: Definition. For s ∈ ℂ, the character x ↦ ‖x‖s of k×, where ‖x‖ is the modulus of x (the scaling factor of additive Haar measure).
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.lpTw: Definition. For s ∈ ℝ, the twist of a Weil–Deligne class x by the unramified character σ ↦ qws·deg σ, where qw = Nw.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.ExtTw: Definition. ExtTw is the proposition that, for every cuspidal assignment r satisfying CuspT and every Langlands extension rc of r, rc(x·νs) is the twist of rc(x) by σ ↦ qws·deg σ for all x and s ∈ ℝ, and for Good x and every smooth character χ, rc(x ⊗ χ∘det) = rc(x) ⊗ (χ∘a).
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.lpChar_lpOfCha: For a Weil–Deligne class x and a smooth character ξ of the Weil group, x ⊗ [ξ] equals the twist of x by ξ.
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.lpSum_zero: x ⊕ 0 = x for every Weil–Deligne class x.
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.charPol_lpTw_lp: For every Weil–Deligne class x, x ⊗ Sp(1) = x, and for every l ∈ ℕ and σ in the Weil group, the characteristic polynomial of (x twisted by q<sub>w</sub><sup>((l−1)/2)·deg</sup>) ⊗ Sp(l) at σ equals ∏<sub>j=0</sub><sup>l−1</sup> of the characteristic polynomial at σ of x twisted by q<sub>w</sub><sup>j·deg</sup>.
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.lpSp: Definition. The special Weil–Deligne class Sp(n) on ℂn: σ acts diagonally by qw(i−(n−1)/2)·deg σ, i = 0,…,n−1, and N is the standard nilpotent shift.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.IsLExt: Definition. rc extends r in Langlands form if, for every list of segments l and every x that is the Langlands quotient of l, rc(x) = ⊕Δ∈l (r(first(Δ)) twisted by qw((len Δ−1)/2)·deg) ⊗ Sp(len Δ).
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.LangExt.charZe: The completion E<sub>w</sub> of a number field at a finite place has characteristic zero.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.LangExt.sumLis: The direct sum of a list of Weil–Deligne classes is unchanged under permutation of the list.
GlobalTheory.LocGL.IsL: Definition. π is the Langlands quotient of the multisegment 𝔪 if, for some ordering Δ1,…,Δh of 𝔪 in which no Δi precedes Δj for i < j, π is irreducible and is the unique irreducible quotient (cosocle) of L(Δ1) × ⋯ × L(Δh), where L(Δ) is the cosocle of the product of the terms of Δ.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.Pr.dual: LanglandsDataDualGL holds: over a characteristic-zero local field k, every multisegment has a Langlands quotient, and if x = L(Δ<sub>1</sub>,…,Δ<sub>h</sub>) then its contragredient is L(Δ′<sub>1</sub>,…,Δ′<sub>h</sub>), where Δ′<sub>i</sub> has the same length as Δ<sub>i</sub> and first term the contragredient of first(Δ<sub>i</sub>)·ν<sup>len Δ<sub>i</sub>−1</sup>.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.ExtDual: Definition. ExtDual is the proposition that, in every such situation (Let E be a number field, w a finite place, A a valuation ring of the algebraic closure Ω lying over w, W ⊂ Gal(Ω/E) the associated Weil group of Ew, a : W → Ew× a local Artin map, r a map on irreducible classes satisfying the cuspidal axioms CuspT, and rc an extension of r to all irreducible classes along Langlands multisegments (IsLExt: rc(L(Δ1,…,Δt)) = ⊕i r(ρi)⊗|·|(ℓi−1)/2⊗Sp(ℓi))), for every n and irreducible smooth representations π, π′ of GLn(Ew) with π Good (all cuspidal support twists of depth-zero cuspidals or characters) and π′ ≅ π̃ the smooth contragredient, one has rc(π′) = rc(π)∨.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.map_summand_dual: Let r satisfy CuspT, and let l = (Δ<sub>i</sub>), l′ = (Δ′<sub>i</sub>) be lists of segments of the same length with each initial cuspidal ρ<sub>i</sub> of Δ<sub>i</sub> Good and Δ′<sub>i</sub> dual to Δ<sub>i</sub> (same length ℓ<sub>i</sub>, initial term ≅ the contragredient of ρ<sub>i</sub>ν<sup>ℓ<sub>i</sub>−1</sup>). Then, termwise, r(ρ′<sub>i</sub>)⊗|·|<sup>(ℓ<sub>i</sub>−1)/2</sup>⊗Sp(ℓ<sub>i</sub>) = (r(ρ<sub>i</sub>)⊗|·|<sup>(ℓ<sub>i</sub>−1)/2</sup>⊗Sp(ℓ<sub>i</sub>))<sup>∨</sup> as Weil–Deligne classes.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.sumList: Definition. For a finite list (y1,…,ym) of isomorphism classes of Weil–Deligne representations, sumList is the class of the direct sum y1 ⊕ ⋯ ⊕ ym (the zero representation for the empty list).
GlobalTheory.T.weilDeligneParam_dual_lis: For Weil–Deligne classes over W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub>: (y<sub>1</sub>⊕⋯⊕y<sub>m</sub>)<sup>∨</sup> = y<sub>1</sub><sup>∨</sup>⊕⋯⊕y<sub>m</sub><sup>∨</sup>; (y⊗|·|<sup>s</sup>)<sup>∨</sup> = y<sup>∨</sup>⊗|·|<sup>−s</sup> for s ∈ ℝ, where y⊗|·|<sup>s</sup> multiplies ρ(σ) by q<sup>s·deg σ</sup>; and (y⊗Sp(n))<sup>∨</sup> = y<sup>∨</sup>⊗Sp(n) for every n.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.LExtInj.isIrrW: If y is an irreducible Weil–Deligne class (ρ irreducible), then y⊗|·|<sup>s</sup> is irreducible for every s ∈ ℝ.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.LExtInj.lpTw_i: For Weil–Deligne classes y, y′ and s ∈ ℝ, y⊗|·|<sup>s</sup> = y′⊗|·|<sup>s</sup> ⟹ y = y′.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.Segment.isCusp_first: For every segment Δ over a nonarchimedean local field k, its initial term ρ (an irreducible representation of GL<sub>d</sub>(k), d ≥ 1) is cuspidal.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.Segment.ext_first: Two segments with the same initial cuspidal class ρ and the same length are equal.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.ExtInj: Definition. ExtInj is the proposition that, in every such situation (Let E be a number field, w a finite place, A a valuation ring of the algebraic closure Ω lying over w, W ⊂ Gal(Ω/E) the associated Weil group of Ew, a : W → Ew× a local Artin map, r a map on irreducible classes satisfying the cuspidal axioms CuspT, and rc an extension of r to all irreducible classes along Langlands multisegments (IsLExt: rc(L(Δ1,…,Δt)) = ⊕i r(ρi)⊗|·|(ℓi−1)/2⊗Sp(ℓi))), rc(x) = rc(y) with y Good implies x = y.
GlobalTheory.T.perm_of_weilDeligne_speci: Let (y<sub>i</sub>, m<sub>i</sub>) and (y′<sub>j</sub>, m′<sub>j</sub>) be finite lists of pairs with each y<sub>i</sub>, y′<sub>j</sub> an irreducible Weil–Deligne class and m<sub>i</sub>, m′<sub>j</sub> ∈ ℕ. If ⊕<sub>i</sub> y<sub>i</sub>⊗Sp(m<sub>i</sub>+1) ≅ ⊕<sub>j</sub> y′<sub>j</sub>⊗Sp(m′<sub>j</sub>+1), then the two lists are permutations of each other.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.LExtInj.eq_of_: Assume LanglandsMultisegments. Let k be a nonarchimedean local field of characteristic 0 and 𝔪 a multisegment. If x and y are irreducible representations of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) that are both Langlands quotients attached to 𝔪 (cosocles of the standard product of the segment representations L(Δ) in standard order), then x ≅ y.
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.eig: Definition. For a Weil–Deligne class x = (ρ, N) and σ ∈ W, eig(x, σ) is the multiset of eigenvalues of ρ(σ), counted with multiplicity (the roots of its characteristic polynomial).
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.charPol_moni: For every Weil–Deligne class x = (ρ, N) and σ ∈ W, the characteristic polynomial of ρ(σ) is monic.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.ExtDim: Definition. ExtDim is the proposition that, in every such situation (Let E be a number field, w a finite place, A a valuation ring of the algebraic closure Ω lying over w, W ⊂ Gal(Ω/E) the associated Weil group of Ew, a : W → Ew× a local Artin map, r a map on irreducible classes satisfying the cuspidal axioms CuspT, and rc an extension of r to all irreducible classes along Langlands multisegments (IsLExt: rc(L(Δ1,…,Δt)) = ⊕i r(ρi)⊗|·|(ℓi−1)/2⊗Sp(ℓi))), for every irreducible x of GLn(Ew): dim rc(x) = n; x has a cuspidal support s with char.poly. of rc(x)(σ) equal to ∏y∈s char.poly. of r(y)(σ) for all σ ∈ W; and if x has central character ω, then |det rc(x)(σ)| = |ω(a(σ))| for all σ, with det rc(x)(σ) = ω(a(σ)) when x is Good.
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.prod_roots_pro: For a finite multiset s and monic polynomials p<sub>i</sub> ∈ ℂ[X], the product of the roots (with multiplicity) of ∏<sub>i∈s</sub> p<sub>i</sub> equals ∏<sub>i∈s</sub> (product of the roots of p<sub>i</sub>).
GlobalTheory.T.centralCharacter_eq_prod_: Assume BernsteinZelevinskyFiniteness. Let k be a nonarchimedean local field of characteristic 0 and x an irreducible smooth representation of GL<sub>n</sub>(k) with cuspidal support s and central character ω. Then there are characters ω<sub>y</sub> of k<sup>×</sup>, with ω<sub>y</sub> the central character of y for each y ∈ s, such that ω = ∏<sub>y∈s</sub> ω<sub>y</sub>.
GlobalTheory.SmGL.IrrCl: Definition. For a topological group G, IrrCl(G) is the set of isomorphism classes of irreducible smooth complex representations of G.
GlobalTheory.Published.chevalleyUnits': ChevalleyUnits holds: for every number field E and positive integers m, b there is a positive integer a coprime to b such that every unit u ∈ 𝒪<sub>E</sub><sup>×</sup> with u ≡ 1 mod a is the m-th power of a unit.
GlobalTheory.localArtinExists_holds: LocalArtinExists holds: for every number field E, finite place w and valuation ring A of Ω̄ over w, there exists a local Artin map a : W<sub>E<sub>w</sub></sub> → E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup> in the sense of IsLocalArtin.
GlobalTheory.ArtinLocalInj.artin_localId: Assume ChevalleyUnits. For every number field E, every global Artin map art : 𝔸<sub>E</sub><sup>×</sup> → Gal(Ω/E)<sup>ab</sup> (IsGlobalArtin) and every finite place w, the composite E<sub>w</sub><sup>×</sup> → 𝔸<sub>E</sub><sup>×</sup> → Gal(Ω/E)<sup>ab</sup> of the local idele embedding with art is injective.
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.ArtEx: Definition. ArtEx is the proposition that for every number field E, finite place w and valuation ring A of Ω̄ over w there is a unique homomorphism a : WEw → Ew× satisfying IsLocalArtin.
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.isoSetoid: Definition. The equivalence relation on pairs (n, (ρ, N)), with (ρ, N) a Weil–Deligne representation of WEw on ℂn, given by isomorphism of Weil–Deligne representations (a linear isomorphism intertwining both ρ and N).
GlobalTheory.SmGL.contra: Definition. The smooth contragredient ρ̃ of a representation ρ of G on V: the smooth vectors of the algebraic dual V*, with (g·l)(v) = l(ρ(g−1)v).
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.IsTameWD: Definition. A Weil–Deligne class x is tame if it has a representative (ρ, N) on ℂn with ρ(σ) = 1 for every σ ∈ W in the wild inertia subgroup.
GlobalTheory.PRep.fixed: Definition. For a representation ρ of G on V and a subgroup H ≤ G, the subspace VH = {v ∈ V : ρ(h)v = v for all h ∈ H} of H-fixed vectors.
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.Weil: Definition. For a valuation ring A of Ω over the finite place w of E (q = Nw), the Weil group W ⊂ Gal(Ω/E): the elements σ of the decomposition group of A acting on the residue field as an integral power of Frobenius, i.e. σ(x)qb ≡ xqa mod 𝔪A for all integral x and some a, b ∈ ℕ.
GlobalTheory.SplitWeil.KOne: Definition. For a nonarchimedean local field k with ring of integers 𝒪, the principal congruence subgroup K(1) = ker(GLn(𝒪) → GLn(𝒪/𝔪)) = 1 + 𝔪Mn(𝒪), viewed inside GLn(k).
GlobalTheory.SmGL.ofChar: Definition. For a character χ : G → F×, the one-dimensional representation of G on F in which g acts by multiplication by χ(g).
GlobalTheory.WeilDeligne.WD.lpOfChar: Definition. For a smooth character χ : W → ℂ×, the class of the one-dimensional Weil–Deligne representation (χ, N = 0).
UpperTheory.Zero.LLC.TypeLaw: Definition. TypeLaw(rc) is the depth-zero type condition: whenever Ew ≅ ℚg continuously, E′ ⊃ E is a number field with a place w′ over A unramified over g with Nw′ = gn, a′ is a local Artin map for E′w′, K = 𝒪E′/w′ ≅ 𝔽gn, θ is a regular character of K× and τ a cuspidal representation of GLn(𝔽g) with Green character τ(y) = (−1)n−1∑j<nθ(zgj) on elliptic y with eigenvalue z, and σ is an irreducible representation of GLn(Ew) whose restriction to GLn(ℤg) contains the inflation of τ, then rc(σ) has N = 0 and, for every inertia element t of E′ with a′(t) ≡ x mod w′ and z = x mod w′, the characteristic polynomial of rc(σ)(t) is ∏j<n(X − θ(zgj)).
GlobalTheory.LocLanglands.IsLocalArtin: Definition. A homomorphism a : WEw → Ew× is a local Artin map if it is surjective, continuous on inertia, satisfies ordw(a(σ)) = −deg σ, every smooth character of W factors as χ∘a with χ a smooth character of Ew×, and art(ιw(a(σ))) equals the image of σ in Gal(Ω/E)ab for every global Artin map art and σ ∈ W.
UpperTheory.Gal.Int.Geo.weight_one_geome: HolomorphicLefschetzFormula holds: for Z smooth projective of dimension d over ℂ, a correspondence c<sub>1</sub>, c<sub>2</sub> : Y → Z of finite étale maps whose coincidence set F = {y : c<sub>1</sub>(y) = c<sub>2</sub>(y)} is finite, and tangent matrices A<sub>y</sub> at y ∈ F with det(1 − A<sub>y</sub>) ≠ 0, each H<sup>b</sup>(Z, Ω<sup>a</sup>) is finite-dimensional and ∑<sub>b</sub>(−1)<sup>b</sup> tr(c<sub>1*</sub>c<sub>2</sub><sup>*</sup> | H<sup>b</sup>(Z, Ω<sup>a</sup>)) = ∑<sub>y∈F</sub> tr(Λ<sup>a</sup>A<sub>y</sub>)/det(1 − A<sub>y</sub>).
GlobalTheory.LFun.IsHecke: Definition. A homomorphism χ : (𝔸F ⊗F E)× = 𝔸E× → S1 is a Hecke character if it is continuous and trivial on E×.
UpperTheory.TP.W.GoodK: Definition. For a quadratic extension E/F with involution σ and base datum B, GoodK(σ, B) means: E/F is CM with complex conjugation σ; E contains √−d for some positive integer d; 𝒪E is unramified over 𝒪F; the additive character ψ of B is standard (continuous, trivial on F, and ψ(a) = exp(−2πi tr a∞) on archimedean adeles); every finite place v of F inert in E has v ∤ 2, Nv > 3 and ψv of conductor 𝒪v; and ψv has conductor 𝒪v for every v in the finite set of B.
Definition. A base datum for E/F: an additive character ψ of 𝔸F; for each infinite place w of F a complex embedding of E above w; integer vectors mα, mβ indexed by the infinite places; a finite set P of finite places with an F-embedding τv : E → Fv for each v ∈ P; and a further finite place v1 with an F-embedding τ1 : E → Fv1.
Formalism.MainNotions.GlobalTheoryTheory: Definition. 𝔸F, the adele ring of the number field F.
Definition. The data of a rank-n space over E: a matrix J ∈ Mn(E) (the Gram matrix), an 𝒪E-submodule L ⊂ En, a matrix θw ∈ Mn(ℂ) for each infinite place w of F, and an element of GLn(Fv) for each finite place v of F; the hermitian/skew-hermitian, lattice, Cartan and split-basis conditions are imposed separately.
GlobalTheory.UnitaryBC.UA: Definition. For a CM field E, the definite unitary group Un(𝔸E) = {g ∈ GLn(𝔸E) : tḡ g = 1}, with bar the complex conjugation of 𝔸E.
GlobalTheory.WeilM.ResEtaPow: Definition. For an R-algebra E, a subgroup K ≤ R×, a character χ : E× → S1 and n ∈ ℕ, ResEtaPow asserts that for all a ∈ R×, χ(a) = 1 if a ∈ K·NE/R(E×) and χ(a) = (−1)n otherwise.
Definition. The group of homomorphisms (𝔸F ⊗F E)× = 𝔸E× → S1.
GlobalTheory.UnitaryBC.HasWeightAt: Definition. An automorphic representation π of Un(𝔸E) has weight λ at the complex embedding τ if there is a nonzero equivariant map into π from the irreducible algebraic representation of GLn(ℂ) of dominant weight λ (the dual Weyl module), for the subgroup of elements trivial at all finite places and all archimedean places other than τ, acting through the τ-coordinate.
Definition. A character χ of 𝔸E× has infinity type m with respect to embeddings τw (one above each infinite place w of F) if χ(z) = ∏w(τw(z)/|τw(z)|)mw for every idele z with trivial finite component.
